subject: Redwood quickstart: intro call & technical attendee
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@acme.io>
Date: Sat, 16 Mar 2029 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood quickstart: intro call & technical attendee

Hi Amit —

Thanks for signing up for a Redwood trial! Quick note to confirm we received your signup and to offer next steps so we can get you up and running quickly. You can pick a time that works with this link: https://cal.redwood.com/meet/naomi. If none of the slots fit, reply with a few windows and I’ll have our SDR coordinate.

A few items that help us prepare:
- What’s the primary use case you want to evaluate (chat, embeddings, reranking)?
- Any compliance/regulatory constraints we should be aware of?
- Will a backend engineer join the call (recommended for technical integrations)?

I’ve attached a one-pager and a short demo agenda so you know what to expect.

Attachments: [Attachment: product-one-pager.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: demo-agenda.txt (TXT)]

Looking forward — I’ll loop in Monica from SDR to help with scheduling and any contract/PO questions.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Growth | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

---

Date: Sat, 16 Mar 2029 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood quickstart: intro call & technical attendee

Hi Naomi —

Thanks — I grabbed the 10:30am PT slot on Tue, Mar 19 via the calendar link. Our main goal is to evaluate latency/cost for a real-time chat feature, plus embeddings for search. I’d like to have one of our platform engineers on the call: Lina Park (lina@acme.io).

Two quick asks: can you send a calendar invite that includes an engineer from your side, and do you have any short notes on network requirements?

Regards,
Amit Shah
Head of Product, Acme Cloud
amit@acme.io

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@acme.io>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Mar 2029 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirming Tue 19 10:30am PT — Redwood intro + eng sync

Hi Amit —

Thanks for scheduling and for confirming an engineer will join. I’m Monica from the SDR team — I’ll be your handoff for the demo and logistics.

I added Vivek (our platform engineer) to this thread; he’ll cover integration patterns and network requirements during the call. I’ve sent a calendar invite to you and Lina for Tue, Mar 19 10:30am PT (see stub below). If Lina prefers a different time, reply with 2–3 alternatives and I’ll reschedule.

Calendar: [Calendar invite: Redwood Intro — Tue Mar 19 10:30am PT]
Drive prep doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDemoDocs

Quick network checklist for Lina/Vivek:
- Allow outbound HTTPS to api.redwood-inference.com (443)
- If using a private deployment, we’ll provide an IP list and proxy docs during the pre-call prep
- For KV cache throughput testing, ensure the test harness can send variable-length token streams (we can share a sample script)

See you on Tue — Monica
Monica Patel
SDR | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

Attachments: [Attachment: agenda-v0.2.pdf (PDF)]

Hi Amit / Lina —

Quick note ahead of Tuesday’s session —
- I’ll plan to cover integration options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and an outline for a short smoke-test you can run during the trial.
- Attached is a lightweight network checklist and a sample token generator script you can use to simulate chat traffic.

Attachments: [Attachment: network-checklist.md (MD)], [Attachment: sample-token-generator.py (PY)]

If Lina has any specific constraints (VPC, egress controls, corporate proxy), send them over and I’ll tailor the material.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
